evidence.proved: quoted plan card: 'VPS 1000 G12.5 - 4 vCore (x86) - 8 GB RAM - 128 GB SSD - Traffic included - 12 months contract period, from monthly - EUR 14.50 / EUR 16.68 (incl. 19% VAT)'
quoted configuration summary: 'Contract period: 24 months - Location: No preference Europe - Networking: IPv4 + IPv6 Connectivity - EUR 12.32 per month (incl. 19% VAT)'

quoted contract-period selector: '1 month +EUR 4.36', '12 months Save 13%', '24 months Save 27%'; EUR 12.32 + 4.36 = EUR 16.68, and 16.68 less 13% is EUR 14.50, so the three figures are one price ladder on one VAT basis
quoted Product Details: 'Set-up fee EUR 0.00 (incl. 19% VAT)', 'Minimum contract period 24 months', 'Billing period 24 months', 'Shipping charges none'

quoted Features: 'Network traffic - If the average network traffic of the last 24 hours exceeds 2 TB, a temporary throttling to 200 Mbps is applied. The throttling is lifted as soon as the condition no longer applies.' and 'Interface Speed 2,5 GBit/s'
quoted Payment Options: 'Direct Debit', 'Bank Transfer', 'PayPal', 'Credit Card'
quoted rate table: '{"amount":1.0,"base":"EUR","date":"2026-10-23","rates":{"USD":1.1193}}'. This is the rate used for every USD figure in this record

record.notes: The figure is confirmed on two pages: the plan card and the product-page configurator. The card's two numbers are a term ladder, not a net/gross pair: EUR 16.68 is the 1-month rate and EUR 14.50 is the 12-month rate, which the configurator's own 'Save 13%' and '+EUR 4.36' deltas reproduce exactly. All three prices are incl. 19% VAT, which the page states in the card, in the set-up fee line and in the footer disclaimer. The site's country selector offers 'United States 0%', 'China 0%' and 'Other 0%', so a buyer outside the EU may see a lower figure, but the 0% rendering was not read: a ?country=US query parameter did not change the page, so the setting is applied client-side and would need a browser session. Not established: any card hold, debit-card acceptance, and whether the contract auto-renews at the then-current rate or at a stated one; no renewal sentence appears on either page. The VPS 500 sibling record states its EUR 8.26 as 'excl. VAT' and multiplies by 1.1193; the same configurator arithmetic on this page shows 8.26 is the 12-month rate incl. 19% VAT, so that record's arithmetic label is wrong even though its USD figure is unchanged.

extras.price_arithmetic: EUR 14.50 a month incl. 19% VAT on the 12-month term x 1.1193 = USD 16.2298, rounded to USD 16.23. Out of pocket at order: EUR 174.00 = USD 194.76. On the 24-month term EUR 12.32 x 1.1193 = USD 13.79 a month and EUR 295.68 = USD 330.95 at order. A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so the 10 h/day figure equals the monthly figure.
extras.renewal_note: no promotional price is shown and no renewal sentence is published; the configurator prices each term directly, so the term price is the price for the whole term. What happens after the minimum period is not stated.

Currently, we do not provide traffic statistics. It is therefore your responsibility to log your traffic usage yourself.' 2.5 / 5 / 10 TB included by tariff.

record.tooling: mount -t nfs; rclone can front it
record.chaining: NFS target behind a netcup VPS
record.limits_note: Requires an existing netcup vServer/root server. No traffic statistics. You must self-meter or you get frozen mid-month. Upgrades impossible in place (different hardware): you must book a new Storage Space and NFS-copy across.
record.reliability_note: NetApp-backed redundant block storage with high per-gigabyte cost. Exceeding contracted storage space freezes writes and access rather than billing overage.

evidence.proved: Tariff A €6.08/mo (250 GB incl., €0.037/GB extra, 2.5 TB traffic); B €9.72/mo (500 GB incl., €0.030/GB, 5 TB); C €18.23/mo (1 TB incl., €0.024/GB, 10 TB); 'Starts from €0.024 /GB in tariff C'
traffic freeze clause quoted verbatim; 'it is not possible to upgrade your existing Storage Space'
'The price is € 0.012 plus VAT per GB', max 8 TB

record.price_per_tb_month: Tariff C: €18.23 for the first 1 TB (€18.23/TB), then €0.024/GB = €24.58/TB for extra capacity — the marginal TB is MORE expensive than the first, and the traffic cap freezes the volume. Local Block Storage is €12.29/TB. Both are 6–12× Hetzner.
